//: Type-checking + editor support for the vitest suite. Run via `tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit` in `npm run typecheck` — vitest transpiles via esbuild but does NOT type-check, so this is the tests' only type gate. Kept as a standalone `tsc -p` (not a root `tsc -b` reference) to sidestep project-references/composite overlap with `../src`. NOTE: test files never ship regardless (they're unreachable from the app entry, so vite never bundles them) — type-checking them has zero production-bundle impact.
